class.name: GamepadContext
class.brief_description: A named layer of gamepad bindings in [InputRouter]'s context path.
class.description: A gamepad context groups the bindings that apply while one part of the game has focus: a seat, a menu, a vehicle. [InputRouter] keeps a path of contexts, outer to inner: base contexts set with [method InputRouter.set_gamepad_base_contexts], then contexts pushed with [method InputRouter.push_gamepad_context]. For each pad input, the router walks the path from the innermost context outward. The first context with an ungated binding for that input wins it; contexts below are not reached. A context with no binding for the input decides by [member fallback], and a [member modal] context stops the walk either way. If the walk reaches the bottom of the path, the raw pad event passes to Godot. Contexts are identified by [member id]. The router knows a context once a binding, map or path names it; register the resource with [method InputRouter.register_gamepad_context] to apply its [member fallback] and [member modal] settings. An id used before registration inherits and is not modal.

members.member: What happens to an input this context has no binding for.
The name the router, maps and bindings refer to this context by. Must be unique in the project.
A display name for tools and prompts. The router does not read it.

If [code]true[/code], contexts below this one in the path never see pad input. An input this context does not bind follows [member fallback], with [constant FALLBACK_INHERIT] treated as [constant FALLBACK_SWALLOW].
